citations.evidenceText:
Lyapunov Stability Analysis
Main idea:
• We need a method that can prove stability without solving the differential
   equation.
•  Lyapunov’s method does this using an energy-like function.
•    If a positive function 𝑣𝑥 keeps decreasing along system trajectories, the system
    is stable.

Important Note:
•   Stability is not the same as performance.
•  A system may be stable but still respond slowly or poorly.
•  Lyapunov analysis tells us whether the system will settle,
   not how fast in every detail.
